change_summary: Add truthful Muse and Grok host projections, a portable Agent Plugin envelope, Grok Build CLI support, and an explicit inbound-mailbox boundary so outbound-only Work agents are never advertised as comment listeners.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill advances with the portable Muse/Grok host guidance while preserving the same read, consent, retention, and terminal-readback contract.

server_contract.note: The server advertises release 1.7.83 and contract 2026-09-26.1, including the portable Agent Plugin boundary and explicit host-channel readiness.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin versions advance together; standard root Agent Plugin and MCP manifests join the existing Claude/Codex envelopes.

workspace_cli.note: The CLI discovers Grok/Muse Skill locations and adds a bounded Grok Build project Runner; Muse Code remains MCP-only until its unattended permission boundary is verified.

help_center.note: Localized Help distinguishes Muse Code/hosted Muse and Grok Build/Grok Bot, including Marketplace and inbound-listener boundaries.

package_setup.note: Package setup and security guidance document portable Agent Plugin installation, direct Muse Code MCP, Grok Build compatibility, hosted-mode limits, and release 1.7.83.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records the historical comment root cause, capability-based mailbox eligibility, Code/Work matrix, presentation choices, official source audit, and external gates.

external_marketplaces.note: Cursor Marketplace submission and fresh Grok Bot acceptance remain account-owned external gates; Meta exposes no public Muse submission route as of the audit date.

public_release_assets.note: The canonical exporter will include the portable root manifests and regenerate both immutable archives from synchronized 1.7.83 source.

release_evidence.note: Contract, identity, OAuth, CLI, package, Help and comment UI tests verify provider classification, listener truth, release bytes, and user-visible status.
